Actuarial life table of grouped times

Source: R/stkflw.R
lftab.Rd

How long cases take, from the counts of cases ending (and censored) in each band of time: the conditional probability of ending in each band with the censored counted as half a case at risk, the survival (the share still open at the end of each band) with Greenwood's standard error and a plain, log or log-log interval, the hazard, and the median, linear within its band.

Usage

lftab(breaks, events, cens = 0, level = 0.95, ci = "log-log")

Arguments

breaks

The band edges, increasing (the last may be Inf), or band labels as bandx() reads them ("0-3", "Over 12"), contiguous.

events

The cases ending in each band: numbers from 0.

cens

The cases censored in each band: one number or one per band.

level

The level of the intervals: one number between 0 and 1.

ci

"log-log", "log" or "plain".

Value

An object of class lftab, a list: tab (lower, upper, entering, atrisk, events, cens, q, surv, se, lo, hi, hazard), median (Inf when survival stays above one half or crosses it in an open band) and ci.

References

Cutler, S. J. and Ederer, F. (1958). Maximum utilization of the life table method in analyzing survival. Journal of Chronic Diseases, 8(6), 699-712. doi:10.1016/0021-9681(58)90126-7

Examples

lftab(c(0, 3, 6, 12, 24, Inf), events = c(40, 30, 20, 10, 5),
      cens = c(2, 2, 3, 3, 4))
#> lftab: life table, log-log intervals, median 4.851282 
#>  lower upper entering atrisk events cens         q       surv         se
#>      0     3      119  118.0     40    2 0.3389831 0.66101695 0.04357669
#>      3     6       77   76.0     30    2 0.3947368 0.40008921 0.04548923
#>      6    12       45   43.5     20    3 0.4597701 0.21614015 0.03896034
#>     12    24       22   20.5     10    3 0.4878049 0.11070593 0.03110609
#>     24   Inf        9    7.0      5    4 0.7142857 0.03163027 0.02088777
#>           lo         hi     hazard
#>  0.568007817 0.73860814 0.13605442
#>  0.310878228 0.48760071 0.16393443
#>  0.145266720 0.29631969 0.09950249
#>  0.059213092 0.18020436 0.05376344
#>  0.006579202 0.09308838         NA
